einstellungen.einleitung: Current application configuration — set via environment variables.
einstellungen.hinweis_env: Provider and API keys are set via the env vars LLM_PROVIDER, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASIS_URL.

pipeline.einleitung: The full workflow from seed data to deep interaction — in five phases.
pipeline.phase1: Paste raw text. The LLM extracts people, places, concepts and their relationships.
pipeline.phase2: Detected persons are turned into full personas and registered as agents.
pipeline.phase3: Plan a dual-world simulation. The variable only affects the variant world.
pipeline.phase4: The ReportAgent autonomously invokes statistics and comparison tools and produces a Markdown report.
pipeline.phase5: Deep interaction: chat with the agents or with the report agent.

startseite.einleitung: Create agents with distinct personalities, let them interact in a simulated world and observe how decisions ripple into the future.

agenten.kein_treffer: No agents match the search term.
agenten.name: Name
agenten.saat: Seed keywords (e.g. "climate researcher in Berlin, cautious")

simulation.aus_text_platzhalter: e.g. "climate discussion with scientist and mayor, 5 steps"

berichte.leer: No reports yet. Start a simulation first.
berichte.chat_einleitung: Ask the report agent — it uses tools (statistics, search, world comparison) to deliver concrete answers.
berichte.chat_platzhalter: What do you want to know?

graphrag.einleitung: Paste text — entities and relations are extracted and can then be queried.
graphrag.text_platzhalter: Raw text — e.g. a news article, a report, a protocol.
graphrag.frage_platzhalter: What do you want to know?

vergleich.einleitung: Pick two completed simulations — their stats and reports appear side by side.
vergleich.zu_wenig: At least two completed simulations are required.

batch.einleitung: One template, multiple variable values — sensitivity analysis in one click.

beziehungs_graph.einleitung: All agents and their learned relationships — grows after every simulation.
beziehungs_graph.leer: No relationships yet. Run a simulation so agents get to know each other.
beziehungs_graph.hover_hinweis: Hover a node for details. Click opens the agent page.
